commands.author: Pick-cat

target.title: fix(proxy-capture): guard body-less arrayBuffer reads against oversized responses
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `readCapturedResponseBodyBounded` in the proxy capture runtime would buffer the full response body through `arrayBuffer()` before checking the byte cap when the cloned response lacks a streaming body. A response with an oversized declared `content-length` would still be fully allocated in memory before the post-read check discarded it, violating the function's bounded-read contract.

## Why This Change Was Made

The body-less fallback path (reachable with non-standard Response clones) now checks the `content-length` header before calling `arrayBuffer()`. When the declared length exceeds `maxBytes`, the function returns `{ truncated: true }` immediately without materializing the body. The stream path (normal ReadableStream clones) already enforced the cap correctly via chunked reading with `reader.cancel()`.

## User Impact

Operators running the debug proxy capture with large or hostile provider responses get the same OOM guard in the body-less path that already exists in the stream path. No config or API surface changes.

## Real behavior proof

**Environment:** Node.js v24, real `readCapturedResponseBodyBounded` exported function. Body-less fallback tests use mock clones (`body: null`) to force the `!body` branch; stream-path tests use real `Response` objects.

**After fix — body-less fallback tests (mock clone, 3 cases):**

```
[case 1] content-length exceeds cap: returns truncated, arrayBuffer() NOT called
  ok: truncated
  ok: buffer empty
  ok: arrayBuffer spy not called
[case 2] content-length within cap: falls through to arrayBuffer(), returns body
  ok: not truncated
  ok: body matches
  ok: arrayBuffer called once
[case 3] missing content-length, within cap: falls through to arrayBuffer()
  ok: not truncated
  ok: body matches
  ok: arrayBuffer called once
```

**After fix — stream path tests (real Response, 3 cases):**

```
[case 4] content-length within cap: returns body
  ok: not truncated | ok: body matches
[case 5] missing content-length, within cap: returns body
  ok: not truncated | ok: body matches
[case 6] stream body within cap: returns body (regression guard)
  ok: not truncated | ok: correct size
```

**Negative control (content-length precheck removed, same tests, same environment):**

```
FAIL: skips body read when content-length exceeds cap (body-less fallback)
TypeError: The first argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer...
  → arrayBuffer() was called (returned undefined), guard is proven load-bearing
```

**Focused tests:**

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/proxy-capture/runtime.test.ts
Tests  14 passed (14)  (8 existing + 6 new)
```

**Lint/format:** `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` clean on changed files.
